series.overall_design: Sequencing of total mRNA from three independent clones, comparing early-passage human retinal microvascular endothelial cells (HRMECs) to replicative and Etoposide-induced senescent counterparts.
series.title: RNA accumulation in aged endothelial cells links an interferon gene signature to cellular senescence
